verdict.rationale:
Ente Auth syncs codes end-to-end encrypted across all devices (docs-27, docs-34), so on a new phone a user simply logs into their existing account and their tokens reappear automatically—effectively a single guided step. Community feedback corroborates that switching devices via export/import was 'very easy' (ente-auth-comm-6), and offline-mode users can restore via password-protected local/CLI backups (docs-7, docs-8, docs-9, docs-11, ente-auth-probe-rt-1).
Missing for 10: no explicit first-party step-by-step 'new phone setup/restore' walkthrough, and no independent hands-on account of the exact new-device login-and-sync flow.
